title: Need advice for retro video game porting
author: CrippledGoose316
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I am currently using Codex to help me port video games to the 3DO Video game console. I'm nearly finished porting the first Mortal Kombat to the 3DO with amazing success.  However, it can get costly. 

Is there a 100% local setup I could use where I could chat with it as I do to Codex, and work together on it coding and me doing the play testing?  I understand nothing is going to be as effective or as fast as the cloud based models, and I am perfectly fine with that.  I have an Intel I9-14700K CPU, 32 GB of RAM, and an RTX 5080 GPU.   I've read the starting point is Ollama, but what is the best local coding agent I can use to get me as close to what I'm using with Codex as possible?

Any advice would be great! Thanks!
